description: seed.rs: for every email that starts a new thread (plain-simple, html-attachment, multi-mailbox, large-email, html-only, no-subject, custom-keywords, very-old, special-headers, child-mailbox-email, sort-test-1/2/3), the code uses threads.entry(name).or_insert_with(|| email.thread_id.clone()). or_insert_with is appropriate when the key may already exist, but for these emails the key is always new. The pattern was copy-pasted from the thread-alpha case where the key is explicitly pre-inserted to hold the value for later replies. For the non-thread-alpha cases, threads.insert(name, email.thread_id) is clearer and removes the false impression that the entry guard is necessary.
title: seed.rs: threads.entry().or_insert_with() pattern is redundant for non-threaded emails
